description: This file declares interface functions for performing merge operations with ORT (Ostensibly a specific merge strategy). It includes function prototypes for non-recursive, recursive, and generic merge wrappers, all with rename detection and different levels of recursion or ancestor handling.

methods.name: merge_ort_nonrecursive
methods.description: Performs a non-recursive, rename-detecting three-way merge, mimicking the old merge_trees() function.

methods.name: merge_ort_recursive
methods.description: Performs a recursive, rename-detecting three-way merge with ancestor consolidation, mimicking the old merge_recursive() function.

methods.name: merge_ort_generic
methods.description: Performs a generic, rename-detecting three-way merge with support for multiple merge bases, mimicking the old merge_recursive_generic() function.
